keyword: what time does masters coverage start today
claims: Final round coverage of the 2026 Masters on Sunday, April 12 begins at 12 p.m. ET on Paramount+, Masters.com, and the Masters App.
The TV broadcast of the final round coverage is on CBS from 2–7 p.m. ET.
Early streaming options, including featured groups and Amen Corner, start as early as 9:20 a.m. ET on Prime Video and other platforms.
Featured Groups coverage is from 9:20 a.m. – 7 p.m. ET on Paramount+, ESPN App, Prime Video, Masters.com.
Amen Corner coverage is from 11:15 a.m. – 6 p.m. ET on Paramount+, ESPN App, Prime Video, Masters.com.
Early Round 4 Coverage is from 12 p.m. – 2 p.m. ET on Paramount+.
Main Broadcast is from 2 p.m. – 7 p.m. ET on CBS, Paramount+, or via FuboTV.
The final pairing of Rory McIlroy and Cameron Young tees off at 2:25 p.m. ET.
